title: UDF Handoff
description: Minimum contract for handoffs between humans, services, or orchestrated agents in a UDF-aligned project.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this handoff document shape (e.g. 1.0.0).

correlation_id.description: Unique id for this handoff attempt; used for tracing and idempotent processing.

artifact_refs.description: Paths, commit SHAs, or URIs to artifacts included in this handoff.

evidence_refs.description: Links to tests, metrics, CI runs, or other verification evidence.

open_risks.description: Risks or open questions for the receiver.

requested_decision.description: Explicit decision requested from the receiver or gate (e.g. Go/No-Go, scope choice).

metadata.description: Optional envelope: timestamps, pipeline run id, etc.

id.description: Stable identifier (login, agent name, service name, role id).
